data.title: Chat: lanes — relPathOf must realpath the repo root (symlinked root marks every lane outside-repo) and lane.key must not collide for two outside-repo worktrees sharing a basename (AS-99 N1/N2)

data.body: CONTEXT (filed by cto-owen from Ruben's AS-99 cycle-2 review, loop tick 8). N1: relPathOf in apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs is a string-prefix compare, while git worktree list emits realpath-canonical paths; a symlinked repoRoot marks every lane '<outside repo>/...', main checkout included. Not live today (the watcher's START line records the canonical path) but the F2 fix turned a loud misconfiguration into a quiet one. Fix: realpathSync(repoRoot) in makeLanesOps plus a symlinked-root test with a mutant observed red. N2: lane.key collides for two outside-repo worktrees sharing a basename (observed: 2 distinct keys for 3 lanes); cardinality holds, only AS-103's join key is affected — route the key shape with AS-103's planning if that lands first. Tag chat; scheduling per the Chat-set rule by age.

PLAN written (Opus under the Fable fallback; tick watcher:26252 loop tick 16). Approach: N1 — makeLanesOps gains an injected realpath (default realpathSync.native, ENOENT falls back to the path as given with a warn-once) and canonicalises the root once per evaluate(), root only (rows are already canonical from git; a row.main shortcut would hide the misconfiguration rather than fix it). N2 — relPathOf's outside-repo marker becomes '<outside repo>/<basename>#<8 hex of sha256(path)>': distinct per absolute path, stable across polls (a hash, not an ordinal, so the AS-100/AS-103 liveness join key does not shift when a sibling worktree is removed), still leaks no directory component and still starts with '<'. lib/lanes.js expected unchanged. 10 numbered ACs, each naming its falsifier; 10 anchored mutants with exact red sets (incl. the asymmetric one: defaulting realpath to identity must red the real-symlink test T6 while the injected-stub tests stay green). 6 new tests, 1 rewritten; predicted host +6 -> 560/559/0/1 against the 554/553/1 master base (AS-120 +1 and AS-106 +17 stack on top if they merge first). Branch feat/AS-108-lanes-realpath-root; Marcus implements, Ruben reviews (he filed N1/N2). Premise check: both defects confirmed in code at 6dbfef1; N1 is still not live (START line shows the canonical root) but nothing prevents it.
